name: Heartwoven

angles.text: Menethil Harbor serves as a critical Alliance port in the Wetlands, where everyday civilians rely on travelers to keep the perilous marsh routes safe.
Upon receiving the reed heart and learning her partner survived, Caitlin immediately sets out to prepare a warm, hearty meal to welcome him home.

faq.answer: Heartwoven is an Alliance quest based in the Wetlands. An adventurer aids Ardin Grassman, stranded at the excavation sites out in the marshes, who crafts a woven token of reeds as a message of survival and love to deliver to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

Caitlin Grassman is an Alliance resident waiting anxiously in Menethil Harbor. She fears for the life of her husband, Ardin, who went out to the excavation sites amid the hazards of the Wetlands, and is profoundly relieved when you bring her word of his survival.

The reed-woven heart is a handcrafted token fashioned by the stranded gatherer from the marsh reeds in his pack. He braids it quickly to serve as proof and reassurance that he is alive and returning home soon.
The quest concludes with Caitlin Grassman, who is waiting in the Alliance port town of Menethil Harbor on the western coast of the Wetlands.
faq.q: Where do you turn in Heartwoven?

faq.answer: The quest is offered by Ardin Grassman, Caitlin's husband, who survived danger at the excavation sites out in the Wetlands. After an adventurer clears a safe path for him, he rests, gathers his bushels, and sends the adventurer ahead with a handmade token for Caitlin.
faq.q: Who gives you the quest Heartwoven?

faq.answer: Ardin went to the excavation sites to see strange towering grasses and was trapped when agitated wildlife, spiders above all, overwhelmed the excavation team. Thanks to an adventurer clearing a path through the surrounding threats, he survived and was able to safely gather his bushels and head back to Menethil Harbor.
faq.q: What happened to the stranded gatherer?

sections.body: Out in the treacherous marshes of the Wetlands, life and labor carry constant peril. Ardin Grassman, who went out to see the strange grasses at the excavation sites, found himself stranded amidst the swamp's dangers until a passing traveler cleared a path through the wilderness. Exhausted but determined, he pauses to catch his breath and secure his harvest before heading back toward the safety of the port.
sections.title: A Signal from the Marshes

sections.body: Before making the trek home, the gatherer takes marsh reeds from his pack and braids them into a woven heart. He entrusts this token to the adventurer to carry ahead to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor. In the bustling coastal settlement, Caitlin waits in deep worry, clutching the woven reed heart to her chest in relief upon hearing that he survived and will soon return for a warm meal.
sections.title: Tokens of Menethil

summary: Heartwoven is an Alliance quest in the Wetlands centered on a simple message of survival and affection. After clearing an escape route for a stranded gatherer in the marshes, adventurers carry a hand-braided reed heart back to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
